topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and contextualizes the importance and complexity of the complement system.

topics.label: Principles and Core Mechanics of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the fundamental principles, naming conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biochemical pathways that recognize pathogens and trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector functions through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and promotes inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins that protect host cells from unintended complement destruction.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical manifestations and disease outcomes resulting from deficiencies in specific complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies used by pathogens to evade complement destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture on complement and previews the next topic on the adaptive immune system.
